updates.note: Tells Harborline 6 the drone survey is the most comprehensive early picture after a Gulf Coast hurricane; results go to the county and city.
Quoted by Coastline on the drone survey results going to the county and city 'to inform resource deployment'.
Tells the Ledger the Phase 2 aerial survey gives engineers 'a roadmap' for what to look for at utility sites.
Quoted by Continental Wire on the aerial survey as a roadmap for repair crews.
Says the imagery archive will support future preparedness for the Texas Gulf Coast; thanks NOAA, the Guard and contractors.
Tells Coastline the center is at about seven times normal volume with mutual aid from San Patricio and Bee counties; asks callers to keep 911 for life-safety emergencies.
Quoted by KNCB, in translation, on dispatchers working with mutual aid partners to answer every call.
Gives Harborline 6 the first full call counts: about 2,900 calls Wednesday, a record 2,109 rescue requests Thursday, more than 7,300 in three days.
Tells Continental Wire the center handled more than 7,300 calls in three days and praises dispatchers and Texas Task Force 1.
Confirms to the Ledger the 23 unfounded calls from prepaid phones; describes the pattern and declines to say what it means.
Tells Harborline 6 that 911 is for life-threatening emergencies only and directs water questions to the new NuecesInfoLine.
Quoted by KNCB, in translation: 911 is only for life-threatening emergencies; use the NuecesInfoLine for water questions.
Tells Coastline the center handled more than 44,200 calls in four weeks and is keeping all call records and audio for its after-action review.
Requested additional helicopters from Air Station Houston starting Thursday morning, per the Coast Guard's Wednesday report.
Reports all known stranded survivors in Flour Bluff have been reached; operations shift to Calallen and the northwest mainland.
Announces with the Coast Guard the end of mass rescue after 1,427 rescues; tells the Ledger thermal imaging let teams send a boat to a specific roof.
Calls it the largest helicopter hoist rescue operation in Corpus Christi history.
